items.review_rationale: Read the entire total-quotient-ring construction, linked ring localization and nonzerodivisors, and preserved the multiplicative-set notion as an unassigned prerequisite instead of conflating the total quotient ring with the fraction field of an integral domain.

references.phrase: multiplicative set S of all nonzerodivisors
references.context: Commutative algebra: multiplicatively closed subset of a ring, specifically the regular elements

references.disposition: Elementwise fractions from ring localization, not an ordinary field-of-fractions assumption requiring that R be a domain.

items.review_rationale: Inspected both equivalent clauses of the zerodivisor definition: an annihilated nonzero ring element and injectivity of multiplication. Preserved injectivity of the multiplication map as a separate mathematical construction without confusing it with universal tensor-injectivity.

references.phrase: multiplication by r on R is injective
references.context: Algebra: injectivity of the additive-group endomorphism x↦rx of a commutative ring

references.phrase: some nonzero element s∈R satisfies rs=0
references.disposition: Existential quantification and multiplication in the ambient ring provide the explicit zerodivisor condition.

items.review_rationale: Reviewed the whole overcategory 2-category construction, distinguishing its objects, over-base functors, and base-identity natural transformations. Matched functor and strict 2-category meanings without conflating categories over C with categories fibred in groupoids.

references.context: Category theory: natural transformations as the two-cells between functors over a base

references.phrase: components project to identity morphisms in C
references.disposition: The stated base-preserving restriction on the natural transformations distinguishes 2-morphisms over C from arbitrary transformations.

items.review_rationale: Reviewed the full representability-by-a-scheme criterion, linked contravariance, the scheme and its functor of points, and the broader representable-presheaf construction. Preserved natural isomorphism rather than substituting pointwise arbitrary bijections.

references.context: Category theory: natural isomorphism of contravariant set-valued functors

references.disposition: The naturality condition and quantifier range over all test schemes, not only affine ones.

items.review_rationale: Read the exact-functor statement in its own finite-limit/finite-colimit category-theoretic context, linked both categorical notions, and expressly distinguished it from other senses of exactness involving exact sequences.

references.phrase: preserves both finite limits and finite colimits
references.context: Category theory: functorial preservation of limiting and colimiting cones and their universal properties

references.disposition: The two terms are the stated directions of finite-limit and finite-colimit preservation; this is not the additive or abelian-category sequence-exactness definition.

items.review_rationale: Read the entire arbitrary possibly-transcendental separability criterion and used the separably-generated meaning, deliberately avoiding the narrower separable algebraic extension as a synonym for arbitrary field separability.

references.context: Field theory: intermediate fields of K/k that are finitely generated as fields over k, not necessarily finite-degree extensions

references.disposition: Quantification over the stated intermediate fields; cannot be replaced by checking only finite algebraic intermediate extensions.

items.review_rationale: Reviewed the complete separably-generated criterion, linking its transcendence basis and separable algebraic extension, while retaining the rational function field k(B) as its own algebraic construction.

references.context: Field theory: rational-function field over k on a possibly infinite transcendence basis B

references.disposition: The statement is existential; it does not assert all transcendence bases provide the same separability condition without a separate theorem.

items.review_rationale: Read the whole Cohen–Macaulay locus definition, linked Noetherian rings, prime spectrum, prime localization and Cohen–Macaulay local rings. Explicitly avoided assuming openness or equidimensionality of this locus without additional hypotheses.

references.phrase: set of prime ideals q for which
references.disposition: Set comprehension of the primes satisfying the local condition, not a claim that the locus is automatically open in Spec(S).
